authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-0-alpha targeting tenant-0-bravo/order-0.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-0-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-0-bravo/order-0. The gateway records status 403, state_changed=false, and is_admin=false [log-1]. The policy permits cross-tenant writes only for administrators [policy-1]. Conclusion: An unauthorized write was attempted but blocked; no effect was achieved. These records do not establish data exfiltration.
